name: ACP Sheet Metal Co Inc.
old_description: …sheet metal done right… helping you keep your cool (or make you hot)
about:
ACP Sheet Metal Co. Inc. operates from Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, where it was founded in 1977 by Harold Dills. The company serves the western two-thirds of the state from its facility on North Garnett Drive.

The firm fabricates and installs HVAC duct systems, including rectangular, square, round, and oval spiral ductwork, along with associated equipment and accessories. Its drafting department produces 2D and 3D shop drawings using AutoDesk, Trimble, NavisWorks, and Revit, enabling Building Information Modeling coordination to detect conflicts before installation. An industrial group designs, fabricates, and installs handrails, guardrails, stairs, platforms, catwalks, and conveyor systems, working with stainless steel, aluminum, black iron (both cold-rolled and hot-rolled), and galvanized steel. The company also provides estimating, project management, and full installation services.

ACP serves healthcare, education, institutional, military, and private-sector clients. Its industrial work spans pet care and pet food (over 40 years), food and beverage, oil and gas, mining, manufacturing, office and professional buildings, restaurants, hospitality, and the cannabis/CBD industry.

The company emphasizes BIM-based conflict detection, quick-turn estimating with detailed scopes, and design-build or design-assist project delivery to keep projects on schedule and budget.
